_comment: Bucket lifecycle for the log-archive bucket (docs/LOGGING_PLAN.md §5.5). Apply with: aws s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket YOUR_BUCKET --lifecycle-configuration file://deploy/aws/s3-lifecycle.json (strip the _comment keys first, or manage via IaC). App logs: Glacier at 90d, expire at 400d. Audit logs: Glacier at 90d, never expire — bucket-side retention is the durable complement to the box-side 90/365-day local pruning.
